title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.0037291618601 (+0.0680% over #7697) by hub reroutes on the chart-595 banked circuit
body:
## Conditional κ ≥ 0.0037291618601: hub reroutes on the #7697 banked circuit

This is +0.0000025329831 (**+0.0680%**) over the #7697 upper endpoint 0.0037266288770.

The change generalises #7682's role-230 reroute. One `P → Q` edge moves to a hub chart `R` that `Q` already feeds, and one `Q → T` edge is re-sourced at `R`. The other values on the cut are re-solved exactly, and each receiver restores its old value from its own local donors. Twenty-one such reroutes change 42 paid edges of the #7697 circuit. Each preserves rank mass, so the gain is pure concavity.

| Per native invocation | #7697 | This PR |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Paid edges / public roles | 6,142 / 1,502 | 6,142 / 1,502 |
| Paid histogram change | | `{1:+8, 2:+6, 3:−26, 4:+5, 5:+6, 6:−1, 7:+2}` |
| Local terms | 170,652 | 170,719 |
| Grid / coefficient bits | 2,083,725 × 2¹⁸ / 13 | same |

The invoice keeps 101,824 paid jobs, 21,168 targets and S = 1,328. The certified crossing is in (0.00372916186012, 0.00372916186013).

**Check** (`python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-banked-hub-reroutes`, or `python3.12 -I -B verify.py` in the package; standard library only, about 100–130 s):

- Rebuilds the pinned #7669 word.
- Checks locality and an acyclic schedule.
- Checks that every edge is GF(2)-nested with positive rank and that its symplectic rank equals the dimension difference.
- Runs an exact Gaussian column simulation of the 25 chart pairs absent from the #7669 word, with a non-nested control rejected.
- Proves exact rational outputs: 400 mains equal the #7669 word and all 1,102 helpers return their own input.
- Prices with PRICEKIT on the literal 16-call caller.

**Premises.** The result rests on the same five selected-framework assumptions as #7674, #7682 and #7697, plus the parent's banked-storage realization. Private homes are unchanged because paid rows and width are unchanged. The only cost change is the term-dependent local services (+67 terms per native). Package: `research/p104-banked-hub-reroutes/` ([README](research/p104-banked-hub-reroutes/README.md) · [Proof](research/p104-banked-hub-reroutes/PROOF.md) · [Physical accounting](research/p104-banked-hub-reroutes/PHYSICAL.md)).

**CI prerequisite.** As in #7697 and #7704, the branch carries ToikY's inherited CI replay repair (#7257, commit `0eabc624`) so canonical CI can reach the package replay. The scientific change is the single commit in `research/p104-banked-hub-reroutes/`.
